patch_description: This rewrite keeps the feasibility-by-construction idea (barycentric parametrization) from the softmax program but replaces the slow, ill-conditioned Powell-in-logits approach with a fundamentally better-conditioned scheme: (1) parametrize directly in barycentric weights with a clean simplex-projection (clipping + renormalization) instead of softmax logits, which distorts gradients near the boundary; (2) optimize a top-k "active-set" soft-min — only the k smallest triangles drive the objective — which concentrates the optimizer's effort on the binding constraints instead of averaging over all 165 triples; (3) use L-BFGS-B with annealed temperatures, which is far more efficient in 33 dims than Powell was in 33 dims of logits; (4) multi-start with deterministic perturbations around a hand-designed symmetric seed plus reflected-pair starts. A strictly-positive min-area guard with a rescue restart prevents the silent-degenerate failure mode observed in earlier generations.
